verdict.rationale: Square documents a broad public API surface you can drive programmatically. It covers Payments, Refunds, Disputes, Payouts, Invoices, Subscriptions, OAuth and GraphQL, with official SDKs, an interactive API Explorer working against real Sandbox and production resources, and llms.txt guidance written for agents. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found all candidate paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: API Explorer is an interactive web application you can use to build, view, and send HTTP requests that call Square APIs.
Use the OAuth API to connect your application to a seller's account using OAuth.
One GraphQL query can retrieve data that requires multiple Square API calls.
The Square TypeScript library provides convenient access to the Square APIs from TypeScript.
API Explorer lets you test your requests using actual Sandbox or production resources in your account such as customers, orders, and catalog objects.
